thesis: Powell Industries: custom switchgear + e-houses — direct physical-constraint play on data-center electrification, real earnings since 1947. Event risk is BEHIND us; the flush is the entry. Mechanism: forced de-rate of a momentum name meeting sticky demand backlog; we buy the capitulation, not the momentum. Bear case (pre-written): backlog growth stalls as data-center orders digest; margin compression on fixed-price contracts; 42x trailing PE re-rates to industrial norm ~20x = $100s. Leading indicators: next quarter backlog number, book-to-bill < 1.
condition: Entry validity: only while price is within ~5% of 211. If it runs past 222 before approval, withdraw — no chasing.
